subject: Cognitive Science
title: Identity Formation
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Identity Formation.

hook.text: Goth one month, athlete the next. Teens try on identities like outfits. It's Erikson's identity crisis.

buildup.text: Erikson said adolescence is a struggle between identity and role confusion. You must find your self.

discovery.text: Marcia expanded this into four statuses: diffusion, foreclosure, moratorium, and achievement.

twist.text: Foreclosure—committing without exploring—seems stable but often collapses under new experiences.

climax.text: Modern research extends identity formation into the twenties. Emerging adulthood is now recognized.

punchline.text: Finding yourself takes longer than expected.

quiz.question: What are Marcia's four identity statuses?
